description: Retrieve canonical metadata for one paper ID, such as an arXiv, PMC, PMID, or DOI identifier. Returns the title, abstract, authors, categories, source IDs, and dates as markdown.

paperId.description: Canonical paperId or primaryId such as `arxiv:1706.03762`, `pmcid:PMC12530322`, `pmid:40953549`, or `doi:10.1016/j.neunet.2025.108095`.

name: firecrawl_research_inspect_paper

agent_hints.description: Optional response guidance from the Firecrawl API.

paper.description: Canonical metadata for the requested paper, absent when it was not found.

authors.description: Authors, as a comma-joined string or as `{name, affiliation}` entries.

createdDate.description: Date the paper was first indexed or published.

ids.description: Source identifiers by namespace, such as `arxiv`, `doi`, or `pmid`.

primaryId.description: Display identifier, ordered for citation and fetch use.

updateDate.description: Date the paper was last updated.

title: Firecrawl inspect research paper
